messages:
maria_sales: Zenith POC locked for next Tues. They plan 300 qps peak, ~1.8k tokens/generation, mixed chat + embeddings spikes. Need presales runbook: reserved GPU recommendation, autoscale policy, KV/preheat steps, and pricing delta for reserved vs burst. Who can help?

sam_se: On it. Quick q: is traffic steady 300 qps or spiky? any tail-latency SLO? Also what model family? customer said 'redwood/llama-2-70b' earlier.

maria_sales: Spikey — baseline 150 qps, peaks to 300 qps for ~10-15min every hour. SLO 99th <= 600ms. Model pinned to rwd-70b-qat.

alex_dev: For rwd-70b-qat we'd recommend a reserved pool of 4x A100s for baseline, with autoscale to 7 during spikes (fast spin-up via prewarmed instances). Estimated steady throughput ~140-180 qps per 4 GPUs with continuous batching + KV cache. Burst to 300 qps needs +3 GPUs.

alex_dev: Autoscale suggestion (example):
```
{ "min_replicas": 4, "max_replicas": 7, "scale_policy": "cpu+queue", "scale_up_threshold": 0.75, "cooldown_sec": 30 }
```
Use queue depth + token-rate metric, not CPU-only.

sam_se: KV cache warmup: run prefix warmup for top 10 prompts and also enable prefix cache for embeddings. Preheat timeline: start 1.5-2 hours before expected traffic and run incremental warmup for 30-45m. Command: `./ops/preheat --model rwd-70b-qat --concurrency 32 --prompts warmup_prompts.txt`.

jordan_fin: Pricing delta: Reserved pool (4 A100) + burst to 7, rough ARR impact: reserved commit ~$18k/mo (committed capacity discount), burst credits add ~$6k/mo at expected burn. If they go pure on-demand bursts it's ~2-3x more. I'll draft exact quote.

ops_oncall: Also note AZ spread for resilience — recommend at least 2 AZs for the reserved pool to meet SLA. Eviction plan: fallback to a lower-cost 30b model with auto-fallback policy if capacity constrained.

maria_sales: Perfect. Can someone create the runbook and a capacity ticket? Need details for customer security questionnaire re: isolation and audit logs.

alex_dev: I'll create the runbook: will include autoscale json, preheat scripts, kv-warmup list, fallback mapping, and runbook steps for ops. Link draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/zenith-capacity (will update)

jordan_fin: I'll add pricing appendix and contractual language for commit vs burst credits.

maria_sales: Awesome — meeting in 30 to walk the POC plan. @alex_dev @sam_se @jordan_fin please join. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: Created ticket INF-2154 'Zenith POC capacity prep' assigned to alex_dev, due in 48h.
